hints.title: Base Case
hints.text: If n is 1, the smallest positive integer whose digits multiply to 1 is simply '1'.

hints.title: Greedy Digit Extraction
hints.text: To minimize the number of digits in the answer, greedily divide n by the largest possible single digits from 9 down to 2.

hints.title: Feasibility and Sorting
hints.text: If n does not reduce to 1 after attempting divisions by 9 through 2, output -1. Otherwise, sort the digits ascending.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Greedy factorization with digits 9 down to 2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all positive integers from 1 upwards times out for large n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(log n) auxiliary storage for digits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Factorize greedily by largest single digits from 9 down to 2.
